snippet.title: Kingdom Ascension - Indie Game (Free Demo)
snippet.description:
We are a small team of two, and this is our first game! After countless days and nights of hard work, the free demo is finally live on Steam. The game is still in development, but we couldn't wait to let you experience it and help us improve it. If you enjoy our demo, please leave your valuable feedback—it means the world to us!
If you think our game is worth looking forward to, don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330160
